'''Shemari''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] and a [[librarian]]. 

==Appearance, Strength and Personality==
Shemari is a vigorous, square-faced woman. She is often too proper in her behavior to the point of seeming to mock those she is greeting; she had been known to curtsy to Egwene from a hundred paces away. 

She is quite weak in the [[One Power]], needing to link with another Aes Sedai in order to weave a [[gateway]].{{ref/book|10|17}}

==History==
She is a librarian.

==Activities==
She taught Egwene as a [[novice]].

She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].

She is spotted by [[Egwene al'Vere]] leaving the Traveling grounds with [[Phaedrine]]. They were only just pinning on their cloaks so they must have been somewhere warm or inside.
